description: placet-research stays silent unless the project contains research/canvas.md; SessionStart injects a ≤4 KiB canvas summary and fails open; PreToolUse denies any write that creates an [accepted] statement, alters a [stated] or [accepted] statement, promotes a proposal, or writes decisions.md at all (the harness seals every entry), and fails closed when it cannot judge a diff. The guard also fails closed when it times out, crashes or cannot start: its onFailure is block, so Claude Code blocks the tool call instead of letting it through. PreToolUse carries no matcher on purpose: every tool reaches the guard, which is the one place that decides which of them it can judge.
